route: University of Washington -> Burke-Gilman Trail -> Sammamish River Trail -> Marymoor Park -> East Lake Sammamish Trail -> Issaquah

sources.source_name: National Weather Service API - Points Metadata Resolution
sources.access_method: Direct unauthenticated HTTPS GET, requires descriptive User-Agent header
sources.authentication_requirements: None (User-Agent header required for identification, not authentication)
sources.terms_or_usage_constraints: Open data, free for any purpose per NWS API documentation; reasonable/undisclosed rate limit applies
sources.geographic_coverage: All 8 recommended route points, all within NWS Seattle/Tacoma office (SEW) area of responsibility
sources.geometry_availability: Point geometry echoed in response; not a polygon
sources.update_frequency: Static per coordinate unless NWS re-draws grid/office boundaries (documented as rare, per NWS caching guidance)
sources.typical_publication_delay: N/A - metadata resolution, not observational data
sources.documented_rate_limits: Undisclosed specific threshold; NWS documentation states a 'generous' limit for typical use, ~5 second retry on exceedance, no numeric SLA published
sources.recommended_freshness_threshold: Cache indefinitely per coordinate; periodically re-validate (e.g. weekly) per NWS's own guidance that grid assignments can occasionally change
sources.failure_detection_method: HTTP status != 200 (after following the mandatory 301 redirect to the canonical 4-decimal coordinate); application/problem+json body on error
sources.last_known_good_suitability: Yes - cache resolved gridId/gridX/gridY per point as last-known-good
sources.fallback_method: None needed; this is a foundational lookup, not a data feed
sources.research_notes: All 8 route points directly tested 2026-07-29. Every request returns an HTTP 301 redirect from the raw 5-decimal GPX coordinate to a canonical 4-decimal coordinate before returning HTTP 200 - a production fetcher must follow redirects. All 8 points resolve to gridId SEW (single WFO covers the entire route) and county WAC033 (King County) for all 8 points; forecastZone varies (WAZ315 for WP1/WP2, WAZ313 for WP3, WAZ314 for WP4-WP8); fireWeatherZone varies (WAZ654 for WP1, WAZ657 for WP2-WP8). Full detail in API_AND_FEED_TEST_RESULTS.md Section 1.

sources.source_name: National Weather Service API - 7-Day/12-Hour Text Forecast
sources.owning_agency: National Weather Service (NOAA), Seattle/Tacoma Forecast Office (SEW)
sources.access_method: Direct unauthenticated HTTPS GET, requires descriptive User-Agent header
sources.terms_or_usage_constraints: Open data, free for any purpose
sources.update_frequency: Observed updateTime approx. 7-8 minutes prior to fetch in live test; NWS forecasts are typically regenerated multiple times per day per office forecaster cycle (not independently benchmarked over a longer window this cycle)
sources.typical_publication_delay: Not independently measured beyond the single observed updateTime-vs-fetch gap
sources.pagination_behavior: N/A - 14 periods returned in one response, no pagination
sources.documented_rate_limits: Same undisclosed NWS-wide limit as NWS-01
sources.recommended_freshness_threshold: 1 hour, keyed off properties.updateTime (not generatedAt, which reflects response-build time not forecast-build time)
sources.fallback_method: NWS-03 (hourly forecast) or NWS-04 (raw gridpoint data) can substitute for numeric fields if this endpoint fails
sources.research_notes: HTTP 200 confirmed for all 8 gridpoints 2026-07-29. Full payload captured for WP1 (sample-responses/WP1_forecast.json). temperatureTrend returned null (not omitted) when inapplicable - parser must null-check. Full detail in API_AND_FEED_TEST_RESULTS.md Section 2.

sources.source_name: National Weather Service API - Hourly Forecast
sources.owning_agency: National Weather Service (NOAA), Seattle/Tacoma Forecast Office (SEW)
sources.access_method: Direct unauthenticated HTTPS GET, requires descriptive User-Agent header
sources.terms_or_usage_constraints: Open data, free for any purpose
sources.pagination_behavior: N/A - full hourly window (typically ~156 hours) returned in one response
sources.research_notes: HTTP 200 confirmed for all 8 gridpoints 2026-07-29. Adds dewpoint/relativeHumidity vs. NWS-02 but windSpeed remains a formatted string, not raw numeric - use NWS-04 for raw numeric wind. name and detailedForecast were empty strings in the sampled hourly period (not populated at hourly granularity). Full detail in API_AND_FEED_TEST_RESULTS.md Section 3.

sources.source_name: National Weather Service API - Raw Gridpoint Forecast Data
sources.owning_agency: National Weather Service (NOAA), Seattle/Tacoma Forecast Office (SEW)
sources.access_method: Direct unauthenticated HTTPS GET, requires descriptive User-Agent header
sources.terms_or_usage_constraints: Open data, free for any purpose
sources.pagination_behavior: N/A - full time-series arrays returned per field in one response
sources.failure_detection_method: HTTP status != 200; missing expected field keys
sources.fallback_method: NWS-02/NWS-03 for the subset of fields they also carry
sources.research_notes: HTTP 200 confirmed for all 8 gridpoints 2026-07-29. This is the correct source for a normalized/thresholded connector: raw numeric, unit-tagged time series (wmoUnit codes), not prose. Each field is an array of {validTime, value} objects where validTime is an ISO-8601 interval, not a single instant - interval durations vary field-to-field and period-to-period (PT1H, PT2H, PT6H, P1DT6H all observed in one payload) and must be expanded, not treated as fixed-cadence rows. heatIndex/windChill/iceAccumulation keys are present even when the value is null/inapplicable in the current season - confirms null-safe parsing is required, not optional. Full detail in API_AND_FEED_TEST_RESULTS.md Section 4.

sources.source_name: National Weather Service API - Observation Stations and Latest Observations
sources.owning_agency: National Weather Service (NOAA) / FAA (co-located ASOS at airport stations)
sources.access_method: Direct unauthenticated HTTPS GET, requires descriptive User-Agent header
sources.terms_or_usage_constraints: Open data, free for any purpose
sources.geographic_coverage: Recommended 4-station set: SEAW1 (limited-field), KBFI, KRNT, KPAE (full ASOS/METAR) - see gap note for WP4/WP5/WP7/WP8 sparse coverage
sources.update_frequency: Sub-hourly for full ASOS stations (observed timestamps ~10-15 minutes apart across KBFI/KRNT/KPAE at test time); SEAW1 cadence not independently confirmed beyond the single test timestamp
sources.typical_publication_delay: Not independently measured beyond the single-snapshot test
sources.historical_availability: Not tested this cycle (a /stations/{id}/observations time-range endpoint is documented to exist but was not directly queried)
sources.pagination_behavior: Not applicable to /latest; time-range endpoint pagination not tested
sources.recommended_freshness_threshold: 90 minutes for full ASOS stations (KBFI/KRNT/KPAE); do not rely on SEAW1 alone for freshness-critical fields it does not populate (visibility, textDescription)
sources.failure_detection_method: HTTP status != 200; null value fields with populated unitCode/qualityControl keys (confirmed null-field pattern, not missing-key pattern)
sources.fallback_method: Station-list ordering from the API cross-checked against true haversine distance (API order alone should not be trusted - see research notes)
sources.manual_review_requirement: Recommended only for the qualityControl code table (not fully retrieved this cycle - see SOURCE_GAPS.md)
sources.research_notes: All 4 recommended stations tested live 2026-07-29, all HTTP 200 with fresh, populated observations. SEAW1 (NWS Seattle WFO's own Sand Point sensor, nearest station to WP1/WP2/WP3) is confirmed a LIMITED-FIELD station: temperature and windSpeed populated with qualityControl='V', but textDescription empty and visibility/rawMessage null - it is not a full METAR source. KBFI/KRNT/KPAE are full ASOS with textDescription populated confirming genuine METAR sourcing. No full-featured station exists within 10 miles of WP4 (Woodinville), WP5 (Redmond), WP7 (Sammamish), or WP8 (Issaquah) - this is a documented, real observation-density gap, not a research omission. Full detail and per-point distance table in ROUTE_WEATHER_POINT_MAPPING.md and API_AND_FEED_TEST_RESULTS.md Section 5.

sources.source_name: National Weather Service API - Active Alerts (point, zone, county)
sources.access_method: Direct unauthenticated HTTPS GET, requires descriptive User-Agent header
sources.terms_or_usage_constraints: Open data, free for any purpose
sources.geographic_coverage: Point-based (all 8 WPx) and zone-based (WAZ315, WAZ313, WAZ314, county WAC033) queries both tested
sources.geometry_availability: Present in schema but nullable per-alert; the one live alert sampled this cycle had geometry: null and relied on affectedZones/geocode instead
sources.update_frequency: Real-time / event-driven per NWS alert lifecycle (issuance, update, cancellation, expiration)
sources.typical_publication_delay: Not independently measured; NWS alerts are issued directly by forecasters at time of decision
sources.historical_availability: Not tested this cycle (a /alerts (non-active, historical) endpoint is documented to exist)
sources.pagination_behavior: Not observed in this cycle's result sizes (max 4 features in the largest test); NWS alerts API is documented elsewhere to support pagination for larger result sets, not independently confirmed here
sources.recommended_freshness_threshold: 15 minutes (alerts are time-sensitive; poll more frequently than forecast/observation endpoints)
sources.last_known_good_suitability: Yes, but with short staleness window given the safety-critical nature of alerts
sources.fallback_method: None identified; NWS is the sole official alert-issuing authority for this geography
sources.manual_review_requirement: Recommended for Watch/Warning-tier events before any auto-published route-impact claim, per project CLAUDE.md route-impact philosophy
sources.research_notes: Zero active alerts confirmed for all 3 route-relevant queries (WP1 point, WAZ314 zone, WAC033 county) at test time 2026-07-29 - quiet-weather day. Full schema confirmed instead via a live statewide query (area=WA), which returned 4 real Air Quality Alerts for eastern/central WA counties not on this route. IMPORTANT OVERLAP FINDING: the only live alert type observed this cycle (Air Quality Alert) is Lane 03's primary responsibility, not Lane 02's - confirms the work order's documented overlap risk is real and a production filter on NWS event type is required to avoid duplicating Lane 03/04 content. severity/certainty/urgency were all 'Unknown' on the sampled alert - a connector must treat 'Unknown' as valid, not as a parse error. Full detail in API_AND_FEED_TEST_RESULTS.md Section 6.

sources.source_name: WSDOT Traveler Information API - WeatherInformation / WeatherStations (RWIS)
sources.access_method: HTTPS GET, requires a free-registration AccessCode query parameter
sources.authentication_requirements: Required - AccessCode obtained via free self-service registration at wsdot.wa.gov/traffic/api/
sources.terms_or_usage_constraints: Public WSDOT developer program; standard terms referenced on the registration page, not independently reviewed in full this cycle
sources.geographic_coverage: Statewide WSDOT road-weather (RWIS) station network; specific station locations along this route's corridor (SR-522/Bothell Way, I-405/SR-522 interchange, I-90 near Issaquah) not confirmed this cycle because the station list itself requires the AccessCode
sources.available_fields: Not confirmed this cycle - blocked by authentication wall before field-level response could be retrieved
sources.recommended_freshness_threshold: Cannot be set responsibly until the service is confirmed reachable with real data
sources.failure_detection_method: HTTP 401 with a clear plain-text error body was directly confirmed this cycle ('The supplied access code was missing or invalid.') - this is a well-formed, unambiguous auth error, not a broken endpoint
sources.last_known_good_suitability: Cannot evaluate until an authenticated response is obtained
sources.fallback_method: NWS-04 raw gridpoint data (visibility, precipitation, wind) partially substitutes for road-weather-specific fields (pavement condition, road temperature) that only WSDOT RWIS would provide
sources.research_notes: Directly tested 2026-07-29 without an AccessCode (none available or created in this research cycle, per project secrets policy - registering a new WSDOT developer account was judged outside this research-only assignment's authority and is left as a recommended project-owner action). The unauthenticated response confirms the service is live and correctly implemented (clean 401 with a descriptive error, not a timeout or 5xx). Real potential route value: this route crosses or runs alongside SR-522/Bothell Way (Kenmore, WP2/WP3 area) and the I-405/SR-522 interchange (Bothell/Woodinville boundary, WP3/WP4 area) per Lane 01's independently-confirmed WSDOT-01 crossing-zone findings, and the Issaquah terminus (WP8) is near the I-90 corridor - all plausible RWIS station locations for pavement/visibility/wind data materially better than NWS's coarser gridpoint forecast for those exact spots. Classified UNRESOLVED, not REJECT, because the auth wall (not a data-quality or route-relevance finding) is the only blocker. Project-separation note: per project rules, no French/CDM credentials, endpoints, or station-mapping assumptions were reused or referenced in reaching this classification.

sources.source_name: UW Atmospheric Sciences Department Rooftop/Campus Weather Station
sources.owning_agency: University of Washington, Department of Atmospheric and Climate Science
sources.access_method: HTML/JS portal page and legacy command-line tools (uwtail, t) intended for department-workstation shell logins
sources.authentication_requirements: None for the public portal page; the full command-line data-access system requires a department login and is not intended for external/public HTTP polling
sources.terms_or_usage_constraints: Academic department resource; no public API terms of service found; not designed for external automated consumption
sources.geographic_coverage: Single point, UW campus (directly on WP1/route mile 0)
sources.available_fields: Documented (per the department's own manual) to include temperature, dewpoint, relative humidity, wind direction/speed/gust, pressure, precipitation, and solar radiation, updated every minute - but only through CGI plot images and shell commands, not a queryable JSON/REST response
sources.update_frequency: Every minute per department documentation (not independently confirmed via a machine-readable response this cycle)
sources.typical_publication_delay: Not applicable - no stable API response was obtained to measure
sources.historical_availability: Yes, described (hourly/24-hour summaries via shell commands), not machine-accessible externally
sources.documented_rate_limits: Not applicable - no API to rate-limit
sources.recommended_freshness_threshold: Not set - not recommended as an automated source
sources.fallback_method: NWS-04/NWS-05 (WP1 gridpoint and KBFI/SEAW1 stations) fully substitute for this location
sources.research_notes: Directly fetched 2026-07-29. Confirmed the station is real, active, and physically on-route (UW campus), but its only public interface is a JavaScript-rendered plot portal and a legacy department-internal command-line system documented for shell-login use, not a public HTTP API. REJECTED for MVP: no stable JSON/REST response was found or is realistically obtainable for unattended polling, and NWS-04/NWS-05 already cover this exact location (WP1) with a genuine machine-readable API. Retained in the registry to avoid future re-discovery and re-evaluation of the same dead end, consistent with the KC-04-style REJECT documentation pattern used in Lane 01's registry.
